title: hieracium pulchelliforme
intro: Hieracium pulchelliforme, commonly known as the small-flowered hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium pulchelliforme include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium pulchelliforme include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
